spans.s:
ind.
Over, beyond, exceeding, much, very much, &c. it implies general excess, or preeminence.
E.
अप्त to go, and इन् aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
In theatrical language, an elder sister.
E.
अत to go, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A bird.
2 Going.
E.
अत to go, इण् affix: or Uṇādi affix इन्.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Incredible, unworthy of belief or trust.
2 Erring, deviating from the duties of a profession or cast.
f. (-था)
Idle or unmeaning speech.
E.
अति excess or exceeding, and कथा speech: some works substitute for this word, इतिकथ q. v.

m. (-कः)
A tree. See हलिकन्द.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Gigantic.
E.
अति, and काय body.

n. (-च्छ्रः)
1 A kind of penance, eating a handful of food a day for six days, and fasting three.
2 Extreme pain or suffering.
E.
अति, and कृच्छ्र penance.

f. (-तिः)
A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with twenty-five syllables to each line.
E.
अति, and कृति another metre.

mfn. (-शःशा-शी-शं)
Very thin, emaciated.
E.
अति, and कृश thin.

m. (-मः)
1 Going over or beyond, lit. or fig.
2 Surpassing, excelling.
2

Transgressing.
4

Contrariety, opposition.
5 Neglect, aversion, disregard.
6

Privation.
7

A groundless demand.
8 A gallant attack, advance of an army in front of an enemy. See अभिक्रम.
E.
अति over, beyond, and क्रम to go; going beyond duty or daring.

Transgressing.
2

Exceeding, surpassing.
E.
अतिक्रम, and इनि aff.

ind.
Having gone over or beyond. i. e. Exceeded, transgressed, surpassed, overcome, &c.
E.
अति before, क्रम to go, यत् aff.

mfn. (शः-शा-शी-शं)
Thin emaciated.
E.
अति, and क्रश spare; ऋ changed to र.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Transgressed, exceeded, passed the proper bounds.
2 Excelled, surpassed.
3 Passed in time.
4 Attacked, assaulted.
5 Excessive, unlimited.
6 Prolix, diffuse.
7 Disregarded, disliked.
E.
अति, and क्रम to go, aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Exceeding, one who oversteps due bounds.
E.
अति and क्रम to go, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
The sixth of the twenty-seven astrological yogas.

m. (-न्धः)
1 A fragrant grass, lemon-grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.)
2 Champac, (Michelia champaca.)
3 A kind of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
4 Sulphur.
mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Of strong or exceeding odour.
E.
अति, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-लुः)
A creeper.
E.
अति, and गन्धालु a plant.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Arrogant, proud.
E.
अति very, गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Despicable, vile.
E.
अति before, गर्हित reproached.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्त)
Very secret, closely hidden or concealed.
E.
अति, and गुप्त hidden.

f. (-हा)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia, Rox.) See पृष्णिपर्णी.
E.
अति surpassing, and गुहा a hole; rising above the ground.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Going over or beyond, lit. or fig.
f. (-रा)
A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) See पद्मचारिणी.
E.
अतिचर to go beyond, अच् and टाप् affs.

m. (-रः)
1 Going quickly.
2 Going over or beyond.
3 Surpassing, excelling.
4 The passage of a planet from one zodiacal sign to another, in a shorter than common period.
E.
अति before चर to go, घञ् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
A mushroom.
f. (-त्रा)
1 Anise, (Anethum pimpinella.)
2 Barleria longifolia.
E.
अति, and च्छत्र an umbrella.

m. (-कः)
A mushroom.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ती)
A form of metre, a stanza of four lines, with thirteen syllables in each line.
E.
अति, and जगती another metre.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Marching fast or fleet.
E.
अति, and जव quick.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very wakeful, restless.
m. (-रः)
The black curlew.
E.
अति, and जागर wakeful.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Very old.
E.
अति, and जीर्ण old.

n. (-नं)
Very lofty, or very rapid flight of birds.
E.
अति, and डीन flying.

ind.
Much, excessively, exceedingly.
E.
अति, and तरान् aff.

mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं)
Very sharp or pungent.
f. (-ब्रा)
Doob grass.
E.
अति, and तीव्र sharp.

mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
Very pungent, sharp, hot or acrid.
E.
अति, and तीक्ष्म sharp.

mfn. (-थिः-था)
A guest, a person entitled to the rites of hospitality.
m. (-थिः)
1 A proper name, the son of KUŚA, and grandson of

RĀMA.
2

Wrath.
E.
अत to go, and इथिन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-या)
Hospitality considered as a religious duty.
E.
अतिथि, and क्रिया act.

m. (-षः)
Inhospitality.
E.
अतिथि, and द्वेष dislike.

n. (-नं)
Hospitality considered as one of the principal sacraments of the Hindus.
E.
अतिथि a guest, and पूजन worshipping.

m. (-रः)
The rite of hospitality, hospitality.
E.
अतिथि, and सत्कार pious rite.

f. (-वा)
Service of a guest, hospitality.
E.
अतिथि, and सेवा service.

m. (-ता)
A liberal man.
E.
अति, and दातृ who gives.

n. (-नं)
Munificence, giving largely.
E.
अति, and दान gift.

Greatheat.
2

Violent inflammation.
E.
अति, and दाह burning.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Substituted, supplementary.
E.
अति over, and दिष्ट enjoined.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Intolerable, unbearable, not to be borne or endured.
E.
अति, and दुःसह painful.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
In great difficulty or distress.
E.
अति, and टुर्गत badly off.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Very arduous, very difficult.
E.
अति, and टुष्कर difficult.

n. (-रं)
A great distance, afar off.
E.
अति, and दूर afar.

m. (-शः)
Substitution, supplement.
E.
अति, and देश direction.

m. (-षः)
A great fault.

f. (-तिः)
A kind of metre, a stanza of four lines, with nineteen syllables in each line.
E.
अति, and धृति another metre.

mfn. (-नौः-नौः-नु)
Landed from a boat.
E.
अति over beyond, and नो a boat.

n. (-नं)
Exceeding, going beyond bounds.
E.
अति beyond, and पत to go, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-पन्था)
A good road.
E.
अति, and पथिन् a road, a very road.

m. (-रः)
1 A great enemy.
2 One who has conquered his enemy.
E.
अति, and पर a foe.

m. (-तः)
1 Neglect of duty.
2 Transgression, deviation from laws or customs.
3 Contrariety, opposition.
4 Going beyond bounds.
E.
अति beyond, and पात, from पत to go.

n. (-कं)
Heinous sin, the worst of the great sins.
E.
अति, and पातक crime.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
A great sinner, flagrantly criminal.
E.
अतिपातक and इनि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Very capable, of great abilities.
E.
अति, and पारक who traverses.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Very dexterous or clever.
E.
अति, and पेशल clever.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Frequent repetition, uninterrupted continuance.
E.
अति, and प्रसङ्ग connexion.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, powerful.
m. (-लः)
An active soldier.
f. (-ला)
A plant, (Sida cordifolia, and rhombifolia.) See वाट्यपुष्पी.
E.
अति, and बल strong.

m. (-रः)
A great or excessive burden.
E.
अति, and भार a load.

m. (-गः)
A mule.
E.
अतिभार, and ग who goes with.

m. (-भीः)
Lightning, the flash accompanying thunder.
E.
अति, and भी dread.

f. (-मिः)
1 Something more than was expected or aimed at.
2 Extensive land or limits.
3 Improper conduct, exceeding proper bounds.
E.
अति, and भूमि land.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Carefully cherished or protected.
E.
अति, and भृत cherished.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Very auspicious.
m. (-ल्यः)
A fruit, (Ægle, or Cratoeva marmelos.) See विल्व.
E.
अति, and मङ्गल auspicious.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
or adverb
m. (-द्रं)
Much, excessive, unlimited, unbounded.
E.
अति, and मर्य्यादा a limit.

mfn. (-र्त्त्यः-र्त्त्या-र्त्त्यं)
Superhuman, divine.
E.
अति, and मर्त्त्य mortal.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
or adverb
n. (-त्रं)
Much, excessive.
E.
अति, and मात्रा a minute quantity.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
1 Superhuman, more than mortal.
2 Immortal, divine.
E.
अति, and मानुष human.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Free from illusion.
2 Entirely liberated or freed.
E.
अति, and माया delusion.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dry, not wet.
2 Over measured, exceeding.
E.
अ neg. तिमित moist, or अति and मित meted.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Seedless, barren.
2 Entirely liberated or freed.
m. (-क्तः)
1 A creeping plant, (Goertnera racemosa.) See माधवीलता.
2 A tree, (Dalbergia oujeiniensis.)
E.
अति, and मुक्त liberated.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree, (Dalbergia oujeiniensis.)
2 Mountain ebony. See तिन्दुक.
3 A creeper. (Goertnera racemosa, &c.)
E.
See अतिमुक्त.

f. (-दा)
A tree, (Jasmimum arboreum.)
E.
अति, and मोद delight.

m. (-थः)
A warrior of a particular order fighting in a car.
E.
अति, and रथ a chariot.

m. (-थी)
A warrior of a particular class, fighting in a car.
E.
अति before रथ a car, and इनि aff. also अतिरथ.

f. (-सा)
A creeper.
E.
अति, and रस flavour.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Excessive, exceeding.
E.
अति, and रिच to flow, with the participial affix क्त.

f. (-ता)
Increase of bulk or quantity, expansion, enlargement, elevation, &c.
E.
ता added to the preceding.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Much, excessive.
E.
अति, and रिच to flow, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-की-किणी-कि)
More, superior.
E.
अतिरक and इनि aff.

m. (-गः)
Consumption, (Phthisis pulmonalis.)
E.
अति, and रोग disease.

m. (-शः)
A wild goat, or according to some, a large monkey.
mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Very hairy.
E.
अति and रामश hairy.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Very covetous.
E.
अति, and लुब्ध covetous.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Very hairy.
E.
अति, and लोमश hairy.

n. (-नं)
An accident, a circumstance not capable of being prevented or guarded against.
E.
अति, and वर्त्तन being.

m. (-लः)
A kind of grain.
E.
अति, and वर्त्तुल round.

m. (-तः)
A storm, a hurricane.
E.
अति, and वात wind.

m. (-दः)
Opprobrious or unfriendly speech, See अभिवाद.
E.
अति overcoming, वद to speak, and घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
An infant.
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Childish.
E.
अति, and वालक a child.

m. (-टः)
A vicious elephant.
mfn. (टः-टा-टं)
Very fierce, very formidable.
E.
अति, and विकट large or formidable.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Antidote, exceeding or subduing poison.
f. (-षा)
A tree used in medicine, the bark is also employed in dyeing; it is of three kinds; white, red, and black. (Atis or Betula.)
E.
अति overcoming, and विष poison.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Heavy rain.
E.
अति, and वृष्टि rain.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
or adverb
n. (-लं)
Much, excessive, unlimited.
E.
अति, and वेला a limit.

m. (-यः)
Extravagance, great expenditure.
E.
अति, and व्यय expenditure.

mfn. (यी-यिनी-यि)
Extravagant, spendthrift.
E.
अतिव्यय, and इनि aff.

f. (-था)
Excessive pain, agony.
E.
अति, and व्यथा pain.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Extreme pervasion or extension.
2 Going beyond the mark, drawing an inference unwarranted by the premises.
E.
अति, and व्याप्ति spreading.

f. (-री)
A kind of metre; of four lines, with fifteen syllables to the line.
E.
अति beyond, शक्करी another metre.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Very powerful.
E.
अति, and शक्त powerful.

f. (-क्तिः)
Great power.
E.
अति, and शक्ति power.

f. (-ता)
Heroick valor, prowess.
E.
अति, शक्ति power, and ता aff.

m. (-क)
A man of gigantic power.
E.
अतिशक्ति, and भाज् who possesses.

If an adj. mas. only. (-यः) If an adverb n. (-यं)
Much, excessive.
E.
शीङ्^1 to sleep; अति being prefixed, to excel; aff. अच्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

n. (-य्यं)
Excess, quantity.
E.
अतिशय much, and यञ् aff.

adv. n. (-नं)
See अतिशय.
E.
ल्युट् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Superior, exceeding.
2 Increased, improved, &c.
E.
अतिशय, and इनि aff.

Hyperbole.
2

Verbosity, prolixity.
E.
अतिशय excess, and उक्ति speech.

adv. n. (-नं) adj. mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Much, excessive.
E.
अतिशय, and ल्युट् the ante-pen. lengthened.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Exceeded, surpassed, excelled.
2 Increased.
E.
अति before शीङ्^1, and क्त aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

Excellent.
2

Chief, principal.
3 Beautiful, splendid.
E.
अति, and शुभ to shine, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-यः)
A hoard, a great accumulation.
E.
अति, and सञ्चय heap.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cheated, deceived, imposed upon.
2 Explained, declared.
E.
अति, before संहित combined.

n. (-नं)
Falsehood, deceit, fraud, cheating, overreaching.
E.
अति, before सन्धान combining.

n. (-नं)
1 Liberality, giving.
2 Appointing, engaging.
3 A gift, a donation.
4 Slaughter, killing.
E.
अति, and हृज to create, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Severe penance or expiation, especially for the guilt of eating unclean animals; taking as food nothing but cow's urine, cowdung, curds, milk, and ghee, each two days in succession.
E.
अति, and सान्तपन penance.

f. (-म्या)
Liquorice plant.

m. (-रः)
Diarrhoea or dysentery.
E.
अति, and सार what goes; from सृ to go, with घञ् affix; also अतीसार.

m. (-रः)
Diarrhoea or dysentery. See अतिसार.

mfn. (-की-किणी-कि)
Dysenteric, afflicted with dysentery.
E.
अतिसार, and the affixes इनि and कुक्.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Afflicted with dysentery.
2 Cathartic.
E.
अतिसार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Very tremulous.
E.
अति, and स्फिर trembling.

n. (-तं)
Violent laughter.
E.
अति, and हसित laughing.

m. (-सः)
A horse-laugh, violent laughter.
E.
अति, and हास laughter.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Imperceptible, unattainable by the senses.
E.
अति beyond, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं)
Blunt, not sharp, dull, obtuse.
E.
अ neg. तीक्ष्ण sharp.

f. (-ता)
Bluntness. So अतीक्ष्णत्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to the preceding.

mfn. (-छः-छा-छं)
Very desirous, eager, ardent.
E.
अति, and इच्छा wish.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Passed, gone.
2 Passed away, deceased, dead.
3 Liberated from worldly restraint.
4 Surpassed, gone over or beyond.
E.
अति, and इत gone.

m. (-लः)
In gram. the preterite tense.
E.
अतीत, and काल time.

ind.
Much, very much, much indeed.
E.
अति, and इव as, so.

mfn. (-व्रः-व्रा-व्रं)
Blunt, dull, insipid.
E.
अ neg. तीव्र sharp.

f. (-का)
In theatrical language, an elder sister.
E.
अत्ता a mother, and कन् affix, who is, as it were, a mother; it is also written अन्तिका and अर्विका.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Proper for a guest.
2 Hispitable, attentive to a guest.
E.
अतिथि a guest, and ढञ् aff.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
1 Proper for a guest.
2 Hospitable, attentive to a guest.
n. (-थ्यं)
Hospitality.
m. (-थ्यः)
A guest.
E.
अतिथि and ज्य aff.

n. (-क्यं)
Excess, superfluity.
E.
अतिरेक exceeding, ण्यत् aff.
